episodes.synopsis: Things are somewhat calm again, but with Tem's murder unsolved and Louis missing, the school is filled with rumors of hauntings and strange occurrences.
episodes.title: A Teen's Never-Ending Alarm

episodes.synopsis: Rokume, a giant rattlesnake claiming to be the only security guard in the school, approaches Legoshi and asks him to track down the murderer.
episodes.title: The Grey Police Hound Runs

episodes.synopsis: After taking a drastic step against the Shishi-Gumi, Louis faces an impossible choice. The drama club gets a new, very confident member.
episodes.title: Changes

episodes.synopsis: Legoshi is attacked by a powerful carnivore. As Louis earns the trust of the Shishi-Gumi, he loses his own health and peace of mind.
episodes.title: Entangled

episodes.synopsis: While attending school during the day, Legoshi spends his nights in intense training sessions with Gohin.
episodes.title: Call It Like It Is

episodes.synopsis: Louis wants to officially quit school to make a break with his past, but his father refuses to allow it. Haru and Legoshi talk things out.
episodes.title: Fly, O Corrupt One

episodes.synopsis: Tao — a black panther — accidentally injures another student. After Legoshi confronts them, the killer thinks back on how and why they murdered Tem.
episodes.title: Unforgettable Sweetness

episodes.synopsis: After clapping a muzzle on Legoshi, Gohin orders him to capture a beast in the throes of a flesh addiction. Juno ends up spending some time with Haru.
episodes.title: Laughing at the Shadows We Cast

episodes.synopsis: Legoshi is shocked when he meets Louis in the Black Market district. At school, he's disgusted to hear Riz say he'll visit Kibi in the hospital.
episodes.title: A Busted Electric Fan

episodes.synopsis: After Pina makes it clear he won't be intimidated by Riz, Legoshi gets into a bloody bare-knuckled fight with the bear.
episodes.title: The Chef's Suspense

episodes.synopsis: To grow stronger for his New Year's Day confrontation with Riz, Legoshi tries ingesting a moth larva and has an intense hallucination.
episodes.title: Scatter Your Scales

episodes.synopsis: While getting pummeled by Riz, Legoshi realizes that they're not so different: he could easily have succumbed to his carnivorous instincts, too.
episodes.title: The Taste of Rebellion
